query: I have a 77-year-old man to evaluate: among male Medicare patients aged 72–82 who were transferred from another hospital and had unstable angina as the principal diagnosis at admission with discharge recorded, how many total admissions met these criteria?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN transfers t ON a.subject_id = t.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 77 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 72 AND 82 AND d.icd_code = 'I210' AND a.dischtime IS NOT NULL AND t.eventtype = 'transfer' AND a.insurance = 'Medicare';
